statements.subject: server
statements.description: Thus, an RTSP server MUST only allow client-specified destinations for RTSP-initiated traffic flows if the server has ensured that the specified destination address accepts receiving media through different security mechanisms.
actions: verify destination address accepts receiving media via approved security mechanism before permitting client-specified destination

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server SHOULD NOT allow the destination field to be set unless a mechanism exists in the system to authorize the request originator to direct streams to the recipient.
actions: reject or ignore destination field if no authorization mechanism exists to validate request originator

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In these cases, the server may choose another method such as a server-resident authorization list to ensure that the request originator has the proper credentials to request stream delivery to the recipient.
